scene_description: Large indoor warehouse storage area with fluorescent lighting and mirrored pillars, with boxes, crates, supplies and cleaning tools stored on the floor.
summary: 4 possible walkway obstructions found (1 high, 2 medium, 1 low). Review before clearing the area.

findings.object: pile of cardboard boxes and plastic crates
findings.observation: Open and closed boxes, a blue plastic crate and loose items sit directly on the floor, narrowing the central passage.
findings.evidence: Center foreground, in front of the black shelving unit next to the mirrored pillar.
findings.recommendation: Move the boxes and crate onto shelving or a marked staging area and keep the central passage clear.

findings.object: tall stack of cardboard boxes by mirrored pillar
findings.observation: A stack four boxes high stands on the floor and protrudes into the walkway.
findings.evidence: Right of center, next to the mirrored column.
findings.recommendation: Relocate the stack out of the travel path; tall stacks should also be checked for stability.

findings.object: boxes and bags piled along right side
findings.observation: Assorted boxes, plastic bags and packages are piled on the floor along the right edge, narrowing the passage.
findings.evidence: Bottom right and mid-right of the image, along the wall.
findings.recommendation: Clear the items from the floor along the wall or store them in a designated area.

findings.observation: A mop bucket with mops is left standing on the open floor.
findings.evidence: Left side of the open floor, near the gray pillar and shelving.
findings.recommendation: Return cleaning equipment to its storage location after use.
